comparisons.existing_proposition: Ch66 already requires full run identity through cohort membership, render/prompt hash, resolved model/call receipt, annotation provenance and analysis artifact; it separately requires per-example results plus language/region slices, and requires cross-language derivatives to preserve task invariant, label/choice identity, language-specific invalid cases and source-to-target lineage.
comparisons.delta: Hy-MT2 supplies a concrete evaluator correction showing why a content hash alone is not a complete cross-language item identity: response joins use (md5, instruction_lang), md5-only compatibility is explicit, and coverage counts matched test items.
comparisons.rationale: The current Ch66 propositions already require the composite variant identity and forbid silently collapsing language variants. The PR is useful supporting evidence but does not require a new stable proposition or a second owner.
